binding: Stories 6.2 (REL-3 formal soak) and 6.1 (REL-1 physical two-machine demonstration) pin THIS candidate. Any change to server/ or the packaging inputs voids the candidate: cut a new one (re-materialize), rerun the Story 6.3 gates, and restart the soak (docs/implementation/reviews/epic-6-execution-agy.md, 'The Candidate Immutability Law').

source.working_tree_note: This candidate was re-cut on 2026-10-21 after two changes to PACKAGED runtime inputs: the web viewer's boot-descriptor read (web/app.js — it read the descriptor at the wrong level of the API envelope, so the shipped viewer could never connect) and the v0.2.0 version stamp (plugin.json, package.json, server/runtime.mjs's APP_VERSION). The version stamp was applied BEFORE this re-cut deliberately: stamping it after the soak would have voided the candidate a second time. The previous candidate 7dc980fdc379c9a9822979fdd0e3c73401ed12af and the 8-hour soak that PASSED against it remain in git history as the historical record for that artifact; they do not qualify this one.

artifacts.digest_algorithm: SHA-256 folded over every regular file in package-relative path-sorted order: for each file, update with hex(sha256(relative_path)) + '\n' + hex(sha256(file_bytes)) + '\n'; the final hex digest is the tree digest (tests/release-smoke.test.mjs, treeDigest). No metadata (mtimes, modes, inodes) enters the digest.

sm_c1_remeasurement.verification_note: two five-install runs of the final gate on 2026-10-21: ten fresh installs, zero failures, every run inside the rule. The first run (raw mean 0.761 s) was measured while this workstation was under load from the cross-machine demonstration; the second (raw mean 0.551 s) after that work was torn down. Both are recorded; the second is the frozen run.
sm_c1_remeasurement.rule_reading: the ladder delta is exactly the two Chat ID choices (v0.1's room_create/room_join collapse into the two room_direct_open calls); the added choice rows cost 0.181 s + 0.014 s (median), and the ladder with those rows priced out is 0.318 s mean — below v0.1's 0.352 s anchor. 0 failures. No regression beyond the choice.
sm_c1_remeasurement.noise_bounds: declared in tests/release-smoke.test.mjs: adjusted-mean gate at 3x the anchor, raw-mean gate at 5x, both absorbing in-suite parallel-load noise (raw means reach ~1.26 s when the full suite runs concurrently); the recorded numbers above are the quiet-machine human-verdict comparison
